an10.109:1.1: tikicchakā bhikkhave vamanaṃ denti pittasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya semhasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya vātasamuṭṭhānānampi ābādhānaṃ paṭighātāya
an10.109:1.2: atthetaṃ bhikkhave vamanaṃ netaṃ natthīti vadāmi
an10.109:1.3: tañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vamanaṃ sampajjatipi vipajjatipi
an10.109:2.1: ahañca kho taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ vamanaṃ desissāmi yaṃ vamanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati yaṃ vamanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti
an10.109:3.1: katamañca taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ vamanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati yaṃ vamanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti …pe… sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccanti
an10.109:4.2: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa vantā honti
an10.109:4.3: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.109:6.2: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti te cassa vantā honti
an10.109:6.3: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti.
an10.109:6.4: idaṃ kho taṃ bhikkhave ariyaṃ vamanaṃ sampajjatiyeva no vipajjati yaṃ vamanaṃ āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti maraṇadhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsadhammā sattā sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsehi parimuccantīti.
